The race reports show both Ferrari drivers in the points across the year, and the 2013 final standings list Alonso (Ferrari, 242 pts) and Massa (Ferrari, 112 pts). The search results don't include a team-change note for either driver, so I'm relying on that for "whole season."

ANSWER: Fernando Alonso
